name: Deviate Hides
summary: At the Wailing Caverns, Nalpak seeks a use for the strange properties of deviate hides. A disciple of Naralex, he keeps watch above the entrance while his teacher lies trapped in a twisted nightmare. Beneath the Barrens, mutated beasts roam, and Nalpak hopes their skins can serve a practical purpose.

sections.title: Corruption Made Manifest
sections.body: Naralex sought to awaken the springs beneath the Barrens and restore life to the dry plains. Instead, the Wailing Caverns became dangerous. The night elf druid's mind slipped into a terrifying nightmare, and that nightmare reached the waking world. Raptors, crocolisks, vipers, and shambling horrors turned vicious and misshapen, warped by emerald corruption leaking from their dreaming master.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Druid
sections.body: From the rock above the cavern mouth, Nalpak watches the disaster with dread and practical curiosity. He knows the deviate beasts are malignant and unnatural, yet their corrupted forms may yield useful materials. Their tough, warped pelts could help skilled leatherworkers. Nalpak hopes to make durable equipment from the fruits of a tragic nightmare.

faq.answer: Nalpak and his fellow disciples camp high on the skull-shaped rock above the Wailing Caverns entrance. Climb the slopes behind the cave mouth, then carefully drop onto the upper ledge in the eye socket overlooking the oasis.

aliases: why are animals mutated in wailing caverns
faq.answer: Deviate creatures are local beasts transformed by the Emerald Nightmare that escaped from Naralex's slumbering mind. Raptors, snakes, crocolisks, and wind serpents native to the Barrens have become darker and more vicious, with strange magical properties and mottled, unnatural hides.

faq.q: Why does Nalpak want these hides?
aliases: what does nalpak want hides for
faq.answer: Nalpak believes the corrupted beasts' hides have unusual strength and can be put to practical use. He hopes leatherworkers can study and work the pelts into resilient gear.

faq.q: Can any deviate creature drop the hides?
faq.answer: Mutated beasts in the tunnels and interior of the Wailing Caverns carry these skins. Hunters and leatherworkers can find extra pelts by skinning them, beyond those scavenged from their remains.

faq.q: Is Nalpak aligned with the Horde or the Alliance?
faq.answer: Nalpak is a tauren druid and one of the Disciples of Naralex. He remains neutral and accepts aid from any capable adventurer, Alliance or Horde, brave enough to enter the corrupted caves.

aliases: what happened to the druid in wailing caverns
faq.answer: Naralex sought to awaken the Barrens' underground springs by joining his consciousness to the Emerald Dream. The Nightmare seized his slumber instead, turning the caverns into a breeding ground for horrors and leaving him comatose deep within them.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see Nalpak's camp as the surviving disciples' grim vigil over an effort gone terribly wrong. For fellow druids, containing the cavern's mutations is personal.
As an herbalist, you know the abnormal growth feeding the deviate beasts is tied to corrupted flora and underground springs winding through the cavern network.
